decisions.reason: As a click-in track adapter that directly extends the firm's core lighting-system know-how and installed-base compatibility, it is easy for the firm to understand, improve, and support commercially.

An LED luminaire is very close to the firm's established competences in premium interior lighting, so absorptive capacity is high even though model turnover in luminaires creates some normal portfolio risk.

The home automation server box fits the firm's offer but requires more software and control-system learning than classic luminaires, so it carries the highest risk while still remaining related enough to retain and refine.
A luminaire family sits squarely in the firm's existing design, engineering, retail, and advisory capabilities, making it a product the firm can credibly develop further rather than exit quickly.
